definitions.gloss: to understand; to comprehend; to grasp
definitions.explanation: To understand the content or meaning of something that has been communicated.

definitions.gloss: to acknowledge; to agree; to roger
definitions.explanation: Used as an acknowledgment that one has understood a request or instruction and will comply. Commonly used as a short reply meaning 'understood' or 'got it.'

examples.japanese: {状況|じょうきょう}を{了解|りょうかい}した。
{事情|じじょう}は{了解|りょうかい}しました。
{彼|かれ}の{意図|いと}を{了解|りょうかい}するのに{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time to understand his intentions.

examples.japanese: {了解|りょうかい}しました。すぐに{対応|たいおう}します。
examples.english: Understood. I'll take care of it right away.

examples.japanese: {予定|よてい}{変更|へんこう}の{件|けん}、{了解|りょうかい}しました。{調整|ちょうせい}しておきます。
examples.english: Understood regarding the schedule change. I'll make the adjustments.

notes:
Extremely common in daily communication, especially in workplace and messaging contexts. The standalone {了解|りょうかい} or {了解|りょうかい}です is a standard casual-to-neutral acknowledgment.

USAGE:
There is a widespread belief that {了解|りょうかい}しました is rude to use with superiors, and that {承知|しょうち}しました should be used instead. While this is debated among language experts, many Japanese people follow this convention in business settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {了解|りょうかい}しました: understood (polite)
- {了解|りょうかい}です: got it (casual-polite)
- {了解|りょうかい}！: roger! (casual)
- ご{了解|りょうかい}ください: please understand/accept

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {承知|しょうち}する: to acknowledge — considered more appropriate with superiors
- {理解|りかい}する: to understand — focuses on intellectual comprehension
- {把握|はあく}する: to grasp — focuses on getting a complete picture
- {納得|なっとく}する: to be convinced — implies emotional acceptance
